Bug_Title: Unnecessary equality checks should not be made
Bug_Explanation: The code contains unnecessary equality checks that will always return false due to comparing dissimilar types. For instance, comparing an instance of Spatula with an instance of Tree, which are unrelated classes, or comparing a KitchenTool interface instance with a Plant interface instance, which are unrelated interfaces. Additionally, it compares objects with null, arrays with non-arrays, and incompatible arrays, all of which will result in false comparisons.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method in the BugDemoTest class calls the showBug method in the BugDemo class. The showBug method contains multiple equality checks between unrelated types which are flagged by the bug rule. The test case is expected to fail because these equality checks are logically incorrect even though they don't throw exceptions, hence the fail method is used to indicate the test case should fail.
